calls.thesis: Revenue growing 32% with 10M+ developers as Cloudflare broadens from delivery/security into an AI application platform and agent-workflow layer, but at 223x expected $1.26 EPS it is far too expensive here; a dip closer to $250 puts it firmly back in buy territory (analyst average $361, low $160).
calls.price_at_call: Buy on a dip closer to $250; analyst average $361, low $160

calls.thesis: Cloudflare as the management/secure layer between AI agents and models, with authentication and protection built in, on top of its global security/connectivity network; revenue expected up 32% this year and profits up 35% to $1.26/share, $633M operating cash flow and ~$1.7B cash — enough to survive an AI crash and ramp back up.
calls.price_at_call: Up ~38% over 12 months; analyst average target $358 (~21% upside), low target $160 as stated
